notes: pt-BR. A tile extends a city already claimed by another meeple and Gui places his meeple in that same city.

lines.say: boto essa peça aqui fechando nessa cidade
e coloco meu meeple na cidade
mas a cidade já tem o meu meeple ela tá ligada

expect.fact: You can't place a meeple on a feature (city, road, field) that is already occupied after placing your tile; Gui's meeple must go elsewhere on the tile or not be placed.
